objectives_fil: Maitugma ang apat na uri ng talaan sa gamit nito at maipaliwanag kung kanino ihahatid ang kaugnay na impormasyon.
objectives_en: Match four record types to their purposes and explain who should receive relevant information.

sections.takeaway_fil: Halimbawang tala lamang · walang tunay na personal na datos.
sections.takeaway_en: Learning examples only · no real personal data.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tanong na sinasagot: ano ang larawan ng kabahayan? Halimbawa lamang.
sections.takeaway_en: Question answered: what describes this household? Example only.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sino ang nasa grupo? / Sino ang nabigyan ng serbisyo? Mga halimbawa lamang.
sections.takeaway_en: Who belongs to the group? / Who received a service? Examples only.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tamang impormasyon sa tamang tatanggap. Halimbawang form lamang.
sections.takeaway_en: Accurate information to the appropriate recipient. Sample form only.

sections.takeaway_fil: Piliin ang tamang tala, tiyakin ang impormasyon, at linawin ang tatanggap.
sections.takeaway_en: Choose the appropriate record, verify information, and clarify its recipient.

check.prompt_fil: Aling tala ang tumutugon sa “sino ang nabigyan na ng serbisyo”?
check.prompt_en: Which record answers “who has received a service”?
check.feedback_fil: Registry ang tinutukoy ng manual. Ang master list ay paggrupo ng mga tao; ang household profile ay larawan ng kabahayan. Sundin ang pangalan at gamit ng aprubadong lokal na form.
check.feedback_en: The manual describes a registry. A master list groups people; a household profile describes a household. Follow the names and purposes of approved local forms.

assets.alt_fil: Mga halimbawang household profile, master list, registry, at form.
assets.alt_en: Example household profile, master list, registry, and assigned form.
assets.caption_fil: Eskematiko para sa pag-aaral; ang mga label sa aralin ang nagpapaliwanag ng kahulugan.
assets.caption_en: Learning schematic; the authored lesson labels convey its meaning.
